shortDescription: ZEC rose above $1,200 and set a new all-time high, according to Coinglass data. According to ChainCatcher, liquidations across the market reached $44.29 million in the past 24 hours, the highest among all assets, including $41.84 million in short liquidations.

title: ZEC Breaks $1,200 to Hit New All-Time High as $44.29 Million Liquidated
